logical_role_separation_basis: NDF-D1 permits the same base model across roles if execution/prompt-context separation and independent source reconstruction are preserved.

allowed_inputs.purpose: case observations used only for deterministic mapping checks

audit_questions: Does the frozen claim-support snapshot materially support the claim?
Does the claim preserve source population/action/condition scope?
Does the claim add a diagnosis, treatment, or mandatory rule not supported by the source?
For case-mapped claims, is the numerical mapping mechanically reproducible from the authorized observations?
Are uncertainty, update status, and correction lineage preserved?
Would a reviewer using only the frozen audit inputs reconstruct the same bounded claim class?
independence_caveat: This is logical role separation and replay within the same ChatGPT research session, not independent human review. Human review remains mandatory before R1/P1 qualified reference use.
